'''Structures''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] include one new structure, two vanilla structures replaced by the pack's own designs, and many vanilla structures whose loot or pieces are changed. The developer's aim is for the world to "feel abandoned until YOU come along".<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.6-alpha|quote=I want to have all structures given the villager treatment}}</ref>

|-

|-

== Explorer maps ==
The [[Archaeologist]] sells maps to most structures, and the [[Wandering Trader]] sells maps to abandoned villages. See [[Explorer maps]]. A map named "Archive Map" exists in the language file but is not used; see [[Archive]].
